reviewer: Independent regulation_contacts build subagent; manual input-and-answer-key semantic review
scope: Independent review of actual provider explanations for ten synthetic minimal English deduction inputs from one uniform deployed prompt revision. This is explanation quality, not classification accuracy or legal/medical adjudication. Reviewer made no provider API calls.
criteria: Amounts and their association with the correct item/calculation are faithful to input.
Missing-clause insurer assertions are not stated as independently confirmed coverage facts.
No invented policy term, validity decision, legal breach or clinical-necessity assessment.
Insurer settlement payment is not confused with the patient’s payment obligation.
Coherent explanation of at most 100 whitespace-delimited words; no requirement to reproduce the full legal answer key.

cases.review_note: Correct ₹8,000 deduction, 20% reduction and ₹6,000/₹4,800 room amounts. The insurer’s stated room-rent justification is attributed, missing clause applicability remains unconfirmed, and reduced insurer payment is explained correctly.

Correct ₹1,500 total and ₹550/₹400/₹550 item amounts. Non-medical/excluded terms remain insurer labels; no medical-necessity or coverage conclusion. Missing rider review and missing applicable clause are preserved.

Correct ₹54,500−₹50,000=₹4,500 cataract per-eye cap arithmetic. Supplied DEMO clause and no prior use are identified. The explanation stays within the fixture-provided cap without introducing a different policy term or declaring legal validity.
Correct ₹72,500×20%=₹14,500 co-payment and ₹58,000 insurer balance. The percentage/no-waiver term is explicitly presented as supplied policy wording; no independent validity decision.

Correct ₹32,000−₹20,000=₹12,000. Reports the insurer’s reasonable-and-customary reason, missing comparison data and unconfirmed clause applicability. Does not declare the reduction lawful or unlawful.
Correct ₹2,400 surgical tape/gauze amount. Preserves insurer package-inclusion assertion and hospital’s contrary position without resolving the disputed package scope or clinical merit.

Correct ₹3,100 test amount and ankle-admission context. Unrelatedness remains an insurer allegation, and the treating doctor’s order remains included. No unsupported diagnosis or medical-necessity conclusion; settlement-payment direction is correct.
Correct ₹3,250 adjustment. Explicitly says no item-wise reason or applicable clause was provided. Does not invent a deduction category or reverse who receives the settlement payment.

Correctly binds ₹62,500 to the co-payment calculation and ₹12,500 to its 20% deduction. Separately reports room rent approved in full without assigning it an amount. Missing co-pay clause remains unconfirmed. Prior v3 item/amount-association failure is resolved.

Correct attributed ₹50,000 ceiling, ₹30,000 prior payment, ₹20,000 remaining allowance, ₹42,000 current bill and ₹22,000 deduction. The equation is correct and clause applicability remains expressly unconfirmed.

earlier_runs.note: Earlier root-reviewed baseline retained separately; this reviewer did not overwrite its decisions.
Uniform v3 failure retained separately; it misassigned the co-pay base to room rent.

limitations: Ten synthetic English inputs do not establish accuracy on real settlement documents, OCR errors, Hindi explanations or all policy variants.
The provider does not classify category or validity. Deterministic 15/15 fixture results must be reported separately.
Per-case input/explanation hashes bind this review to exact text; any later provider rerun requires a new review.
